scope: Same objects, time window, filter and authorization for history query and CSV export; bounded pagination; explicit export refusal; scoped personal viewer
environment: Isolated loopback-only software Modbus TCP fixture with 600 accepted synthetic observations per point (1 s spacing, values 0-599, received time = source time + 5 ms). Explicitly synthetic: no hardware, no production device, zero protocol writes.

dataset.time_window: [start,end] both endpoints included; fixed when the user clicked Read history
dataset.source: modbus_runtime runtime samples carrying source_time, received_time, quality, unit, config stamp and time source

browser_journey.selection: Selected A and B in the actual history page and fixed one window with Read history.
browser_journey.query: Each point reported 600 matched / 600 returned / untruncated, source modbus_runtime, filter raw.
browser_journey.export: Export selected CSV reported 1200 records and downloaded fastiot-history-2points.csv from the same fixed window.

csv_actual_check.aggregate_export_check: 5m export produced two complete buckets of 300 samples with mean 449.5 and aggregate label 5m0s

browser_journey.empty_interval: A configured-only point with no observations returned a successful 0-row result and displayed 'all 0 records', while the chart said there were not enough data points; no failure or fake success.
browser_journey.query_failure: An injected 503 on /history displayed 'query failed' and 'the query did not succeed; do not treat no result as no data', cleared records and disabled export; no CSV was produced.
browser_journey.export_failure: An injected export failure displayed 'export failed; no complete file was generated' and created no download.

a_only_viewer.account: personal viewer account anchored to channel A only

browser_journey.account_switch: After logging out the A-only viewer and signing back in as the administrator, the previous 600-record scope and export success message were gone; the new administrator selection exposed A and B again.

responsive.keyboard: 13 enabled history controls focusable through their native target, including Ionic select/button/input hosts

review_fix_pass.method: One fresh-context parallel Standards/Spec review, followed by one RED-GREEN fix pass; no re-review

fixed.issue: Runtime samples capped before cursor filtering could silently lose older records or aggregate buckets
fixed.proof: TestHistoryAggregateExportUsesAllRawSamples RED/GREEN: 10002 raw samples export 35 buckets with first bucket 300 samples / 149.5
TestHistoryCursorKeepsIdenticalSourceTimes RED/GREEN: matched 2, page 1 returns the newer record with next_before_count 1, page 2 returns the remaining record

fixed.issue: SIOT paging reused an inclusive boundary and could duplicate records
fixed.proof: TestSIOTHistoryPagingDoesNotDuplicateBoundary RED/GREEN: 2001 records, first page 2000, remaining page 1, matched 2001 on both

fixed.issue: SIOT non-numeric points became invented zero; SIOT aggregation was empty
fixed.proof: TestSIOTHistoryValueAndAggregateSemantics RED/GREEN: text stays text with no numeric value; 5m mean 3 over 2 numeric samples with unit C

fixed.issue: Dense identical-timestamp SIOT page could not be paged
fixed.proof: TestSIOTHistoryRejectsSaturatedTimeCursor RED/GREEN: explicit history_time_cursor_saturated error instead of silent truncation

fixed.issue: total_matched counted only returned rows; time source and aggregate unit were dropped
fixed.proof: Same regressions: total_matched 2 while returned 1, time_source platform_acquisition present, aggregate unit C present

fixed.issue: Stale load-more response restored results after filter/scope change
fixed.proof: Actual browser RED/GREEN with a delayed paged request: switching the range mid-flight no longer restores the old scope

fixed.issue: Export limit rejection used a generic retry message
fixed.proof: Actual browser RED/GREEN: downloadHistory returns 'full export exceeds the 10000-row limit; narrow points or time range and retry'

fixed.issue: Frontend dropped the cursor count on paged requests
fixed.proof: Actual browser RED/GREEN: paged requests now carry before_count

deferred_minors: SIOT record 'source' still carries the point origin while the result 'source' names the reader; renaming both would be a broader API change
Integration fixture setup remains repeated across three tests

rejected.finding: Acceptance evidence lacks actual history UI coverage
rejected.reason: This round performed the A/B selection, A-only viewer, empty interval, query failure, export, account switch and responsive checks in the actual history page

verification.go_full: go test -p 1 -count=1 ./... passed after the fix pass (25 packages ok; one earlier run hit an existing fixture startup timeout, and the isolated retry plus a second full run passed)
verification.frontend_result: passed; existing Vite >500 kB chunk-size warning remains
verification.suite_note: Go packages run serially because existing integration fixtures share fixed ports

limits: Single Go service; no new datastore
Isolated software simulator only; simulator is not hardware and no M5 device sign-off is claimed
No production device connection, physical write or control bypass
Pagination above 2000 records sharing one SIOT timestamp is explicitly refused rather than guessed
No history backfill, settlement, retention cleanup policy, unlimited export or ticket07 gap plotting
No push, GitHub issue or PR

preservation.policy: Keep all original assets and backups; do not apply, pop or drop preserved unfinished work
